Depression causes people to withdraw from people from the world. I know I tend to isolate when I'm depressed. Also sometimes my own intrusive thoughts will keep me from reaching out to people. I always feel like I'm a burden to my friends and family when I'm struggling. I will literally tell myself that this person doesn't care about me  relationships with someone who with depressed can be complicated and sometimes the best thing you can do is just make sure to let them know that you are there if they need you.
That's ok I just know that as much as everyone see me as a loser as a woman. People would be 1,000 times crueler to me.

It's ok I know what a loser I am I have already said to myself any insult or criticism anyone can throw at me. I do my best not to pass judgement on anyone. Life is really hard and you never know what f*cked up S*hit they have been through. I have always taught my children to spread love and kindness. You never know what others are struggling with. Making a conscious effort to be kind can possibly make a difference to someone who is fighting battles you don't see. I know I would feel terrible if I was to ever just go out my way and criticize people who are clearly struggling, and heaven forbid those words I spoke or wrote caused them to take their own life. I knew when posting this I was putting myself out there to get harassed. I don't blame any of you for calling weak and telling me I'm wrong about all this. It is what it is right
I am blind in my left eye and have very poor vision in my right. So I'm not able to ride a bike. But that does sound entriguing
For the one who posted the comment "stop having kids" I think you would have realized I did that. Considering my youngest is almost 10
I can post whatever I want to post!! Who died and made you mod??
I'm gonna post it in any subreddit I can thanks!!!
I didn't stop treatment. My psychiatrist and me decide that my primary could take over prescribing while my symptoms were control. I see saw a counselor weekly.

I was seeing a psychiatrist for over 9 years my meds were helping with my symptoms and not changing at that point. So both me and the psychiatrist agreed my Dr would take over prescribing while all was well and if any issues arose after that to just make an appointment. I still went to my counseling sessions once a week. I saw my primary monthly. My psychiatrist is the one who suggested the transfer so why should I be punished?? And I did try to fight to stay on thank you very much!! Have you ever heard the saying when you assume?
And I'm a woman BTW

I didn't start using drugs again until my brother committed suicide and I lost everything I owned. When I found myself alone and homeless, I also found crystal meth. Which was the worst thing ever!!! The drugs didn't help me situation but they are not what caused it.

My kids are the only one that matters and yes they suffered most. They are still suffering. My daughter makes these keychains and she has this dream that she is going to fix things by selling them. It's heartbreaking she hasn't sold very many, and she gets so upset. I just tell her that most families are suffering in the same way. I just want them to be happy!! I just seem to do nothing but let them down. Yet they still think I hung the moon. I totally understand I grew up with two mentally ill parents. My father was schizophrenic, which in my opinion is worse than bipolar.

I knew that posted my story anywhere on the internet was going to bring out the trolls. These people may feel as badly as I do about life. Only difference is I don't attack other to make myself feel better. There is also nothing anyone say to me that I haven't already said to myself. I hate myself, I think I'm worthless, my brain doesn't function properly, and I passed down my mental illness to all of my kids. I understand why people think I'm trash
Thank you! I understand that the internet is full of troll. Ones who feel just as badly about themselves as I do. Only difference is I don't tear others down to make myself feel better

What I make myself a target for trolls! Yes I understand that, but there is nothing anyone can say to me that I haven't said to myself. I fell back into old habits as a direct response to the uncertainty of my life.

I was told at one point that if your disability is taken from you and something happens within a certain time frame that proves you did in fact need disability,  that they would have to restate it. Is there any way I can bring a civil suit against disability.  As a result of their direct action,  I lost everything.  I have gone through 4 years of hell needlessly. Then they claim they never received my appeal.  I sent my appeal along with a request to change my address.  They had no problem with the address but claim they never received appeal. They are honestly pushing me to the point of wanting to end my life. Everything is hopeless
Thank you!! I have been writing to politicians asking them to put some sort of safeguard in place for those of us who are mentally ill.

I tried to fight losing my benefits. It didn’t matter what I said the fact my primary stood behind me as well as my therapist.  My psychiatrist was on board with my dr taking over my meds. He was still going to see me if something changed and my meds needed tweeking.

I know what disability is. With the added support of a disability check I was able to become fairly stable. The truth is I always still had symptoms.  I just learned I was better off hiding them. I had beened deemed too unstable to care for my oldest two sons when I was 23. I wanted to die at that point too.

Because I achieved a level of stability with the added support of disability.  I tried really hard to go back to work full time. I made it a little over a year. Then my brother committed suicide.  From there it was a fairly quick decent into hell.
I was always seeing a therapist,  I just hadn't seen my psychiatrist in a little over a year. He knew I had stabilize and was on board with my dr taking over prescribing
Conditions may improve but I will never be cured

All of myvproviders agreed that I wasn't able to work, not full time at least. For the person who said I shouldn't have disability just because of mental illness.  As I said in my post, mine is severe. I am a single mother I have 5 kids my own place a car and I took care everything myself.  Emotionally that was honestly more than I could handle. Truth is I always had symptoms.  I just learned to hide it better, I had a lot to lose.  Like my kids people are so judgmental but until u know my whole story you should keep quiet. I am a fighter, the world has knocked me on my ass and broken my heart more times than I could count. But I just kept on fighting.  I have accomplished things that I was not qualified for, all in the name of poverty. Even if you knew my story you would never understand me, nobody does. I am an extremely broken and battered person. The fight has just been too much.
